images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of an indie meta-puzzle PC game, 16:9, full screen, no device frame, no poster framing, no logo. Dark charcoal desktop background. Three side-by-side retro windows with thin title bars. LEFT window titled "양치기.exe" with a green dot: a cheerful 16-bit pixel-art farm game — light blue sky, red barn, small cream farmhouse, green grass paddock fenced with brown wooden posts, exactly three fluffy white pixel sheep, a tiny farmer in a straw hat; a bottom strip reads "금화 6" in gold and "양 3" in white; below the window three flat buttons "양 팔기", "양 사기", "다음 날". RIGHT window titled "지하감옥.exe" with a purple dot: a moody 16-bit pixel-art dungeon game — dark purple stone walls on a 12x7 tile grid, a numbered wooden door "1", a green open door "3", a row of four grey floor spikes, a small knight hero, a gold "▼" staircase tile; a bottom strip reads "체력 6" in red. CENTER, between them, a narrow window titled "공유 메모리" showing a monospace hex dump of 16 columns of two-digit hex bytes in dim grey, where exactly three adjacent bytes "03 06 01" are highlighted in bright yellow boxes, and thin glowing yellow lines run from those highlighted bytes left to the farm's sheep/gold counter and right to the dungeon's door and health counter, making it obvious that both games read the same memory. Below everything a dark terminal-style log panel with a few lines of small green and purple monospace text. Clean flat UI, crisp pixel art inside the windows, one coherent palette, readable hierarchy.

images.prompt: Actual in-game screenshot of an indie meta-puzzle PC game, 16:9, full screen, no device frame, no poster framing, no logo. A single large top-down 16-bit pixel-art level fills the centre: it is a dungeon maze layout (12x7 tiles, corridors, dead ends) but it is DRAWN WITH FARM ART — the maze walls are wooden fences with hay bales, the floor is bright green grass, a row of purple thistles stands where floor spikes would be, numbered wooden pen gates "1" and "3" act as the doors, a small red barn door is the exit, two white sheep wander where monsters would be, and a tiny farmer in a straw hat walks the maze. A vertical glowing yellow seam cuts the level about one fifth from the left: LEFT of the seam the very same tiles are rendered in the other game's art — dark purple stone dungeon walls, grey spikes, a purple slime monster, a small knight — revealing the hidden dungeon underneath. Small yellow monospace labels above the seam read "◀ 지하감옥.exe" and "양치기.exe ▶". Top-left a dark translucent debug panel in monospace lists two processes, a shared memory name "Local\같은주소", heartbeat counters and "0x10 = 01". A horizontal slider at the bottom centre. Charcoal background around the level. Crisp pixel art, one coherent palette, clean readable composition.
